---
title: "Activity 4 - ER relationships"
subtitle: "Choose the concepts, explain the constraints, draw the model"
description: "An ER activity on entities, attributes, relationships, cardinality, diagramming, and participation, designed for approximately 40–45 minutes."
toc: false
---

Distinguish entities, attributes, and relationships, then compare cardinalities in gym, company, and college scenarios. Build a combined college ER diagram, explain a relationship attribute, and reason about participation when requirements change. The activity is designed for approximately **40–45 minutes**, including peer comparison.

::: {.lesson-hero}
# Use the activity worksheet

Feel free to work in a group or as an individual. Compare your draft with another individual or group, then record what you revised or why you kept your model.

[Download the activity Word document](week-07-er-modeling-activity.docx){download="week-07-er-modeling-activity.docx" .btn .btn-primary}

[Download the printable PDF](week-07-er-modeling-activity.pdf){download="week-07-er-modeling-activity.pdf" .btn .btn-outline-primary}

:::

The handout provides blank space for explanations and sketches. Make any additional assumptions explicit. Use the arrow notation from [Modeling a game world with ER diagrams](../lectures/week-06-introduction-to-er-diagrams.qmd).
